feature: Caller wiring to integrate the PinP/UnpinP shim into per-P xid cache and per-P stats counters is deferred to subsequent loops so the shim can land standalone.
PinP/UnpinP shim implementation remains pending; will be completed in a later phase of this milestone.
Full SeqScan/Project plan node migration from opTreeSlab is deferred to a future loop; plannode.go establishes only the foundation.
Splitting state.appendMu's four invariants to enable independent granular locking.
ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN for renaming table columns is not implemented.
SELECT * star-expansion within set operation branches (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP, and CUBE syntax forms are not supported; they are parsed as sentinels but not executed.
ORDER BY clause in aggregate functions (array_agg) is not supported for UUID column types
EXPLAIN output format is not fully implemented for UUID operations
CTEs (Common Table Expressions) without explicit aliases are not recognized by the parser
uuid_extract_timestamp has a timezone parsing mismatch between POSIX (UTC+N) and ISO string format conventions
Role-based access control for INSERT operations is not implemented; SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION remains a no-op so server stays in superuser mode
